name: How often should I get a roof condition assessment for my home?

mainEntity.name: How often should I get a roof condition assessment for my home?

acceptedAnswer.text: It is generally recommended to get a professional roof condition assessment at least once every 1-3 years, or after any significant weather event like a major storm. The frequency can also depend on the age of your roof and the type of roofing materials used. Regular assessments can help identify small issues before they escalate, potentially saving you significant repair costs down the line.
acceptedAnswer.description: Get a professional roof condition assessment every 1-3 years or after significant weather, depending on roof age and materials.
